name: SyademContextualConditions
title: Syadem Contextual Conditions
description:
Contextual conditions defined by Syadem for use in immunization clinical decision support. Each code represents an operational assertion that a condition applies to a patient. These are not diagnoses or clinical findings. Labels are supplied in French and English. This resource is an IVC proof-of-concept representation published with Syadem's permission.

**Proof of concept.** This resource is not a final or normative release. Its structure and metadata are still under review. Source identifiers are permanent.
copyright: © Syadem. Published by IVC with Syadem's permission. This is not an official French-government terminology. Final licence and attribution wording is still to be confirmed with Syadem.
